acceptanceCriteria: Integration candidate freezing uses the existing git diff --cached --check to catch unresolved markers and retains its actual result before commit.
The concrete failed staged README candidate and resolved comparison are retained; both reviewed registry entries survive unchanged.
Any permanent verification change is separately scoped and reviewed; no qualification or native completion is inferred from the marker repair.
body: Observed test gap / integration friction, not a confirmed Corvint runtime defect. Frozen combined landing candidate SHA256 4cfb7e09efc96d87baf11bb828d2257e6b7d4f6eddac5b5c9930a3f779d8a211 contains unresolved markers at docs/specs/README.md lines9,11,13. Focused docs/specindex checks passed because they do not promise README conflict-marker detection; independent git diff --cached --check correctly fails. Review /tmp/lsp-editor-landing-source-review.md requires preserving both exact parent rows and removing only markers. Candidate /tmp/lsp-editor-landing-candidate.diff and manifest are retained. Expected resolved table before integration; actual staged unresolved table. Corvint1.0.0-rc.1 build163, Tasks developer202 (official tasks-dev-20260929.2 binary), Go1.27.1. Current bounded metadata repair is authorized; this ticket records follow-up verification friction, not new feature scope or qualification.
